summary: Strengthen reserve allocation, liquidity, and risk reporting skills in five practical days. Explore the central bank asset management course.
lede: Central bank asset management balances reserve liquidity, capital preservation and returns through governance, allocation and risk oversight. For reserve managers, treasury officers and investment risk analysts, the course develops practical skills in setting investment policies, planning liquidity ladders, assessing duration and exposures, and interpreting stress tests. Participants also practise Excel-based portfolio analysis and reporting, while examining automated monitoring and AI-assisted analytics at an operational-awareness level.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage, analyse, control, or oversee central bank financial assets and reserve portfolios.
modules: Central Bank Mandates and Reserve Governance
Strategic Asset Allocation and Investment Policy
prerequisites: Working knowledge of central bank treasury, reserve management, institutional portfolio management, or investment risk is recommended. Basic Excel use will help with the portfolio analysis exercises. Coding or programming is not required; advanced analytics and AI-assisted portfolio analysis receive operational-awareness coverage rather than implementation training.
